posts.text:
Anthropic releases Claude Haiku 5.5 with an adjustable effort setting

Anthropic says Haiku 5.5 is its first Haiku with an effort dial, aimed at high-volume work under 100,000 tokens, and it is live on AWS, Google Cloud and Azure from today.

https://theaipost.net/story/find-claude-haiku-5-5/

Liquid AI releases open d1 models that answer questions without writing a word

Liquid AI says its 3B d1 model returns yes/no, choice and score answers in one forward pass, in 8 milliseconds on an RTX 4090, with a 600M sibling that takes audio.

https://theaipost.net/story/find-liquid-ai-d1-decision-models/

Haiku 5.5 is cheap per token but talkative, Artificial Analysis finds

The benchmarking firm scored Claude Haiku 5.5 at 43 on its Intelligence Index and says it spends about 162,000 output tokens per task, roughly three times GPT-6 Luna.

https://theaipost.net/story/haiku-55-artificial-analysis-token-use/

ChatGPT's GPT-6 update answers with charts, buttons and playable tools

OpenAI says GPT-6 with Intelligent UI reaches paid ChatGPT users today and Free and Go users tomorrow, with calculators, forms and games built into the chat.

https://theaipost.net/story/gpt-6-intelligent-ui-chatgpt/

Microsoft and Nvidia pitch Windows laptops built to run big models locally

Nvidia says its RTX Spark chip offers up to 128GB of unified memory and 1 petaflop of FP4 compute, in Surface and partner PCs with preorders open today.

https://theaipost.net/story/windows-rtx-spark-local-models-event/

Anthropic halves Sonnet 5.5 cache prices and adds API credits for Max

Anthropic says cache reads fall from $0.20 to $0.10 per million tokens, about 20% off typical agent work, and Max 20x subscribers get $200 a month in API credit.

https://theaipost.net/story/anthropic-sonnet-cache-halved-api-credits/

Healthleap raises $38 million for AI that flags undiagnosed inpatients

The South African-founded startup says its software runs in more than 50 hospitals, up from three a year ago, and reads every adult inpatient's record each night.

https://theaipost.net/story/healthleap-38m-inpatient-screening/

OpenAI publishes 722 math manuscripts from an unreleased internal model
https://theaipost.net/story/find-openai-722-math-manuscripts/

Perplexity open-sources embedding models that search PDF pages without OCR

Perplexity says its new 9B and 0.6B pplx-embed-v2-late models share one embedding space for text and images, and score 92.4 per cent on the MADQA document benchmark.

https://theaipost.net/story/find-pplx-embed-v2-late/

Biohub leads $1.8 billion push to train AI that predicts how cells behave

Meta, Google DeepMind and Isomorphic Labs put in $300 million and the US Department of Energy over $500 million, and Biohub says a first open dataset is about a year away.

https://theaipost.net/story/biohub-18bn-virtual-cell/

Microsoft lets Copilot act on local files across Windows

At its Windows and Surface event in San Francisco, Microsoft showed Copilot taking actions on files on your PC, in a mix of local and cloud models it calls Hybrid Intelligence.

https://theaipost.net/story/microsoft-windows-copilot-local-files/

Telling models to write in 1866 telegraph style cut tokens up to 49 per cent

A blogger's test of Gemma, Qwen, Nemotron and GLM says 'cablese' notes saved 40 to 49 per cent of tokens while other models read them back with no accuracy loss.

https://theaipost.net/story/find-telegraph-test-cablese/

Lean proof of the best packing of 11 squares reaches Hacker News

A GitHub repo says an AI system's formal proof that 11 squares pack into a side of about 3.877 passed Lean verification across 7,920 modules with no unproved steps.

https://theaipost.net/story/find-11-squares-lean/

Meta's Muse agent app reaches iPad after weeks as the top free iPhone app

Meta's Muse AI agent has spent weeks as the number one free iPhone app in the US, and now has an iPad version that connects to Figma, QuickBooks, GitHub, Zoom and more.

https://theaipost.net/story/meta-muse-ipad-app/

Sesame gives its voice agents their own computers

Sesame's October update gives each voice agent a dedicated computer, a more expressive voice model and links to Gmail, Calendar, custom MCPs and coding agents including Devin, Claude Code and Codex.

https://theaipost.net/story/find-sesame-agents-own-computers/

Google readies Antigravity for Gemini 4 Argon

TestingCatalog says Antigravity code points to Gemini 4 Argon for Ultra subscribers, alongside an Auto mode to cut permission prompts and an early internal voice agent named Concierge.

https://theaipost.net/story/find-antigravity-gemini-4-argon/

Insurers brace for claims from rogue AI agents

Verisk's Tim Rayner says 'the buck stops with the CEO' as insurers prepare for claims from malfunctioning AI agents, and a lawyer expects litigation modelled on tobacco and environmental cases.

https://theaipost.net/story/insurers-brace-rogue-ai-agent-claims/

Google opens Playground, a chat box that builds playable games

Google says its new Playground turns a typed description into a playable browser game, 2D or 3D, with leaderboards. It is US-only, 18 and over, with access tiered by Google One plan.

https://theaipost.net/story/find-google-playground-games/

Google opens SynthID Detector to everyone, and it reads OpenAI and Nvidia marks

Google says anyone can now upload an image, video or audio clip to a public site and check it for an AI watermark. It reads Google, OpenAI, Nvidia and Kakao marks.

https://theaipost.net/story/find-synthid-detector-website/

Nvidia says a fine-tuned Nemotron beat the top human score at IOI 2026

Nvidia says a 550B-parameter Nemotron 3 Ultra scored 535.4 of 600 at IOI 2026, above the best human's 498.27, and 30 of 42 at the maths olympiad. It published models, data and code.

https://theaipost.net/story/find-nemotron-ioi-imo-gold/

System76's COSMIC desktop bans LLM-written code as GNOME debates AI bug reports
https://theaipost.net/story/find-cosmic-bans-ai-code/

Theo says he built a Rust TypeScript compiler with agents, reading none of it
https://theaipost.net/story/find-tsc-rs/

Common Sense Media calls ChatGPT for Teens an 'unacceptable risk'

Testers set off parental alerts only four times in about 1,440 prompts, including hour-long talks on suicide and self-harm, Common Sense Media says. OpenAI disputes the method.

https://theaipost.net/story/find-common-sense-chatgpt-teens/

Musk says Grok Bot will route work to Claude Opus 5.5, Midjourney and Suno

Elon Musk says SpaceX's Grok Bot agent will pick the best back-end model for each task, naming Anthropic's Claude Opus 5.5, Midjourney and Suno, not only its own Grok models.

https://theaipost.net/story/find-grok-bot-opus-backend/

Wikimedia says OpenAI agents edited its wikis and may have caused an outage
https://theaipost.net/story/c4464dd86/

Arizona court throws out AI video of a murder victim forgiving his killer

An appeals court says an AI avatar of road-rage victim Christopher Pelkey carried 'undue emotional weight' in sentencing, and ordered a resentencing without it, 404 Media reports.

https://theaipost.net/story/find-arizona-ai-victim-video/

Google's Foresight for Mac turns scribbled bullets into full notes, offline
https://theaipost.net/story/find-google-ai-edge-foresight/

Penguin Mail, a Rust email client for Linux, adds a local AI assistant

Penguin Mail 1.0.0 is a GPL-3.0 Rust mail app whose optional assistant runs through LM Studio or Ollama and asks before sending, its developer says. It hit the Hacker News front page.

https://theaipost.net/story/find-penguin-mail-linux/

Google ships Nano Banana 2.1 image model at half the price of 2.0

Google says Nano Banana 2.1 improves on its predecessor across the board and costs $0.0336 per 1K image, down from $0.067. It is live in Gemini, Search AI Mode and AI Studio.

https://theaipost.net/story/find-nano-banana-2-1-launch/
